title: Deck-related stalk comparison for two embedded power-return summands
statement: Let $k_1/k_0$ be a finite extension of finite fields, let $\ell$ be an invertible prime, and suppose $r>0$ and $\#k_1=(\#k_0)^r$. Let $X/k_0$ be any scheme and let $c:C\to X$ be in a cartesian constant-field square with $C/k_1$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $V$ be any source constructible Weil sheaf [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Write $F_j=((\operatorname{Fr}_X^j)^{-1})_*$ and $\varphi_j:F_j\bar V\simeq\bar V$ for its iterated return [def-zl-source-constant-field-restriction]. Let $P,Q$ be algebras with invertible $F_r$-return and let $i_P:P\hookrightarrow(\bar V,\varphi_r)$ and $i_Q:Q\hookrightarrow(\bar V,\varphi_r)$ be monomorphisms of such algebras. Suppose $j\in\mathbf N$ and an isomorphism $e:F_jP\simeq Q$ satisfy $e\,;i_Q=F_j(i_P)\,;\varphi_j$ on the underlying sheaves. Let $A,B$ be source constructible Weil sheaves on $C/k_1$ whose underlying Weil objects equal respectively the transports of $P,Q$ through the canonical geometric-fiber isomorphism and the power-return comparison [def-zl-source-constant-field-restriction]. Then for every finite point $t$ of $C$ there exists a finite point $t'$ such that $c(t')=c(t)$, $q_{t'}=q_t$, and the source local Frobenius modules $B_t$ and $A_{t'}$ [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] are equivalent. No irreducibility or semisimple decomposition hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Construct the explicit pullback-to-iterate comparisons. Apply the proved abstract strIterate addition identity to obtain commutation of the two ambient returns.

Use the equivariance equations for the monic inclusions and the supplied equality e;iQ=Fj(iP);phi_j. Postcompose the candidate return square with iQ; naturality of the commutor and ambient commutation identify its two sides. Cancel the monomorphism iQ. This is the fully proved generic helper restrict_commuting_returns.

Apply the pure geometric deck-point theorem. It supplies t prime with the same image and residueCard and identifies the underlying point of the actual translated lift. Equal degrees follow from residueCard=q^degree and injectivity of natural powers of q>1. The proved categorical helper fixed_conjugate_power transports the fixed-point square: the conjugate of a power of Fr_X commutes with Fr_C, since the geometric-fibre comparison identifies Fr_C with Fr_X^r.

Apply local naturality for the equivariant translate, using the square just proved by cancellation. This compares the stalk of B at t with the stalkAt of A at the actual translated lift. Apply the source nonempty_equiv_stalkAt to compare that lift with the canonical lift of t prime. Their underlying points coincide and are finite; both fixed-point squares have the same residue degree. Compose the two Frobenius-module equivalences.

theorem exists_stalk_equiv_of_power_orbit
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    {k₁ : Type u} [Field k₁] [Finite k₁] [Algebra k₀ k₁]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k₀ k₁] [Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l)]
    {C : Scheme.{u}} [C.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))] {c : C ⟶ X}
    (hc : IsPullback c (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)) (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ k₁))))
    (r : ℕ) (hrpos : 0 < r) (hr : Nat.card k₁ = Nat.card k₀ ^ r)
    (V : WeilSheaf k₀ l X)
    (P Q : IsoAlgebra (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.frobeniusPowPullback k₀ l X r))
    (iP : P ⟶ (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.powFunctor k₀ l X r).obj V.obj)
    (iQ : Q ⟶ (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.powFunctor k₀ l X r).obj V.obj)
    [Mono iP] [Mono iQ] (j : ℕ)
    (e : (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.frobeniusPowPullback k₀ l X j).obj P.carrier ≅ Q.carrier)
    (he : e.hom ≫ iQ.hom.f =
      (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.frobeniusPowPullback k₀ l X j).map iP.hom.f ≫
        (V.obj.frobeniusPowIso j).hom)
    (A B : WeilSheaf k₁ l C)
    (hA : A.obj = (IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.transportCommIso
      (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberBaseChangeIso hc) r
      (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberBaseChangeIso_hom_comp_geometricGaloisFrobenius
        hc r hr))).obj P)
    (hB : B.obj = (IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso (ProEtaleWeilSheaf.transportCommIso
      (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberBaseChangeIso hc) r
      (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberBaseChangeIso_hom_comp_geometricGaloisFrobenius
        hc r hr))).obj Q)
    (t : C.finitePoints) :
    ∃ t' : C.finitePoints, c t'.1 = c t.1 ∧
      (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard t'.1 =
        (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard t.1 ∧
      Nonempty ((B.stalk t).Equiv (A.stalk t'))
